column2: [intro]
I always wear this charming smile,
But behind it, I’m indifferent all the while.
I pretend to be caring and true,
But my real face is cold and untrue.
I play the role of the nice guy,
But in reality, I can be sly.
Playing with your emotions is my game,
Watch out for me, I’m not what I seem.
I promise you the world and more,
But it’s just to get you on the floor.
I toy with your heart, without regret,
Never thinking of the damage, no sweat.
I play the role of the nice guy,
But in reality, I can be sly.
Playing with your emotions is my game,
Watch out for me, I’m not what I seem.
